summary: Replace nine authenticated OpenAPI 501 placeholders with bounded production adapters over canonical PostgreSQL, workflow and S3 quarantine boundaries.

impacts.evidence: All tenant data reads and mutations derive organization/workspace only from the authenticated request context and PostgreSQL adapters set transaction-local RLS scope.
Privacy intake persists opaque subject references only; upload responses expose bounded hashes/state and plugin/settlement projections exclude credentials and raw provider payloads.
Existing operation IDs and paths are preserved; placeholder 501 responses become typed success/client/error responses in additive OpenAPI 0.11.0.
No event name or schema changes; upload quarantine reuses the existing security.upload.quarantined.v1 transactional outbox event.
Connector SDK roots and capability vocabulary are unchanged; marketplace reads expose the existing safe ListingView.
Adapters read and write tables from existing migrations 000022/23/28/37/39/40/53; no schema migration is required.
Every route remains protected by the production composition; uploads use bounded bytes, server-derived object keys and operator-owned SigV4 credentials with no release bypass.
Reconciliation creation rechecks enabled policy and current connector-account capability; privacy and upload endpoints only enqueue quarantined/pending work and expose no privileged execution bypass.
Privacy uses Task-061 audit capture and upload quarantine persists the existing bounded outbox mutation metadata; financial reads preserve immutable source and FX references.
All retryable POST adapters require bounded idempotency keys and derive tenant-scoped stable job/request/upload identities; duplicate metadata conflicts fail closed.
No webhook surface changes; S3 egress uses one operator-configured origin and a server-derived bucket key.
Former 501s now produce explicit bounded client, conflict and dependency-unavailable outcomes suitable for API SLO measurement.
Rollback can unmount adapters without schema reversal; already quarantined objects and durable workflow/ledger state remain inaccessible or readable through canonical stores.
Route parity rejects 501 placeholders; targeted API, repository, SigV4/config and existing domain tests qualify scope, limits, idempotency and fail-closed storage behavior.
